sentence: Evidence from UK firms points the same way: AI adoption raises innovation performance where it complements the firm's internal R&D spending, and it partly substitutes collaboration with external knowledge partners
passage: [D'Amico et al. (2025), abstract] "Using data from 14,143 firms in the UK between 2004 and 2020, we explore how AI adoption impacts knowledge spillover of innovation." / "Our findings suggest that firms adopting AI can enhance their innovation performance if it complements firm's own investment in R&D. AI adoption can substitute knowledge collaboration with certain external partners."

gemini.note: The sentence accurately reflects the empirical findings of the passage regarding the impact of AI on innovation performance and external knowledge collaboration for UK firms.
